SIEMES

This is a frontend capstone project for the Village88 Bootcamp, completed during a 7-day sprint back in 2023. It earned me the 'Best Capstone' award for that cohort. The MVP focuses on allowing users to create multiple stores, manage products, and customize their storefront themes.

Watch Demo

Role & Accomplishments

Developed a multi-tenant web app like a mini Shopify application. designed specifically for merchants to build and manage their online stores. The application includes a wide range of functionalities such as support for multiple stores per merchant, product management, theme customization, seamless checkout process, and more.

Stack

Mainly using MySQL, ExpressJS, NodeJS, ReactJS, TailwindCSS, S3 Bucket with Cloudfront, Cloudflare R2, and Stripe API

Takeaway: This was a frontend capstone but ended up creating a fullstack app. Unfortunately the codebase in github was accidentally deleted... still you can watch the youtube demo (with timestamps) and my thought process 🤣 on Figma.
